source_read: https://www.avantiwestcoast.co.uk/classes-of-travel/first-class/first-class-service (First Class summer 2026 menus, valid 1 July - 13 October 2026: weekdays Pendolino, weekdays Evero, weekend, each with a non-gluten menu and an ingredients and allergens PDF) and https://www.avantiwestcoast.co.uk/onboard/onboard-shop (shop menu 'Tuck in!', PDF created 12 May 2026), fetched 2026-10-10; robots.txt disallows only /sitecore and /beta
not_verifiable: allergens: the ingredients and allergens PDFs are ingredient lists with allergens in capitals, not a table of the 14 allergens, and the shop menu has none, so no allergens were published or compared
notes: Calories-only chain. The script reads the PDFs' text layer (pdftotext); the re-read used other methods: (1) tesseract OCR of the rendered First Class pages (100 dpi, tiles): 33 of the 35 First Class rows were read back with the same figure, the other two were settled by eye on the page image (Mushroom Bruschetta 351: OCR read 357, the image prints 351; Ploughman's Platter cheese & crackers 382, a variant line); (2) all 22 shop rows read by eye on the 150 dpi page image (every figure matched, incl. the Bacon Roll 373 and gluten free 315, Hot Chocolate 194 and Coffee Syrups 7); (3) the matching First Class ingredients and allergens PDF prints 'Per serving N kcal' for each food row (the weekend one has no figure for Cox&Co Chocolate 85 and prints the others; the figure is on the Pendolino and Evero ones). Not published: calorie ranges, 'Add a poached egg (417 kcal)', and names printed with other calories on different menus (Classic Bacon Roll 459/553/396, Porridge Bowl 252/271, Smoked Salmon with Scrambled Eggs 226/323, Ploughman's Platter 523/423, Hot Chocolate 106/194, Decaf Coffee 0/1).
